composition_host_caveat: Saved up/out 2A plus direct upward adjoints A remain full-parent CPU arrays; forcing/readout and history arrays overlap. This is not an RSS guarantee.

first_state_residency_only_analysis.second_conversion_retained_formula: A_remaining + C_completed <= A for this parent before local scratch.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.improved_forward_order: Compute each first block then forcing immediately; free outside; retain upward until second. Forcing is independent of eligible. Global finite-episode validation still precedes second.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.improved_forward_peak: A plus one outside block and bounded first/forcing scratch; no full pair retention needed.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.host_snapshot_choice: Saving original up/out on CPU preserves current two first-sweep evaluations per update but keeps 2A D2H payload.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.no_snapshot_choice: Release learned GPU states without CPU snapshots, then replay first under no-grad for each second VJP and replay with grad after full history adjoint for combined forcing/first VJP. Three first-sweep evaluations per update, versus current two.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.dependency: Complete history adjoint requires all readout VJPs before forcing VJPs, so second-block graph cannot simply fuse into later first VJP without retaining graphs or recomputing.
first_state_residency_only_analysis.occupancy_limit: Residency removes transfers and CPU indexing/scanning work but retains depth-wise kernels and host launches. It does not alone establish 80 percent useful GPU duty.
